title: Reverse String
description:
Given a single line string `S`, print the reverse of the string.

All characters including letters, digits, and symbols should be inverted in place.
input_format: A single line containing the string `S`.

sample_tests.explanation: Spaces and numbers are preserved in reverse.
Palindrome string remains identical in reverse.

hidden_tests.input: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog
hidden_tests.output: god yzal eht revo spmuj xof nworb kciuq ehT
